newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia Yield Spreads-Outperform in sluggish day.
newsitem.headline: Australia Yield Spreads-Outperform in sluggish day.

text.p: Australian bond yield spreads to the dollar bloc narrowed as the local futures market squeezed higher, although turnover was extremely thin.
The largest move on the day was against Canadian debt which came under pressure on Wednesday as the Canadian dollar broke technical support at C$1.3885.

U.S. Treasuries rebounded in New York and provided the base for the local advance, although this week's correction from Monday's 3-1/4 year lows at the long end has left spreads above their recent lows.
Domestic bonds also outperformed New Zealand, which surrendered some of its early gains by the close and had briefly seen the 10-year Australian/N.Z. margin go positive.
